deliberate-currency.sov.stale.action: Open the oldest instruction file, delete what no longer holds, and note today as its review date.
deliberate-currency.sov.stale.before:
# Project rules
Use the legacy build script for releases.
Pin the old model alias for code review.
deliberate-currency.sov.stale.after:
# Project rules
Owner: platform team. Reviewed: (today's date)
Use `make release` for releases.
deliberate-currency.sov.stale.setup_note: Set a recurring reminder at your review cadence so the next pass starts from a tripwire, not from drift.

deliberate-currency.sov.owner.action: Add an owner line and a review date line to the top of each instruction file.
deliberate-currency.sov.owner.before:
# Project rules
Run the linter before you commit.
deliberate-currency.sov.owner.after:
# Project rules
Owner: (your name or team)
Reviewed: (today's date)
Run the linter before you commit.
deliberate-currency.sov.owner.setup_note: The owner and review line format is this tool's convention; any consistent format works if it is easy to find.

memory.ap.instruction-file-grows.action: Move rarely used sections out of always-loaded files into skills or files loaded on demand.
memory.ap.instruction-file-grows.before: CLAUDE.md holds the whole runbook, every past incident, and the style guide, loaded every session.
memory.ap.instruction-file-grows.after: CLAUDE.md keeps the rules that apply to every task and links to a runbook skill and a style guide file read on demand.
memory.ap.instruction-file-grows.setup_note: Measure the always-loaded size again after the move; each removed line is context every session no longer pays for.

human-in-the-loop.sov.undefined-boundary.action: Replace blanket allow rules with scoped ones and set the default permission mode back to ask.
human-in-the-loop.sov.undefined-boundary.setup_note: Keep a scoped allow list for the commands you run every day; anything outward-facing or destructive still asks.

harness.ap.under-investing.action: Add one extension for the gap named here: a hook for a check you repeat, a skill for a task you repeat, or a memory file.
harness.ap.under-investing.before: Every session starts from the same chat prompt; the test run is typed by hand after each change.
harness.ap.under-investing.after: A post-edit hook runs the tests; a skill holds the release steps; a memory file keeps project facts across sessions.
harness.ap.under-investing.setup_note: Start with the check you type most often; a hook turns it from a habit into a gate.

reproducibility.sov.not-logged.action: Raise the history retention setting so past sessions stay on disk long enough to compare.
reproducibility.sov.not-logged.before: Session history is cleared after the default window, so last quarter's behavior cannot be compared with today's.
reproducibility.sov.not-logged.after: User settings set cleanupPeriodDays to keep 90 days of sessions for comparison.
reproducibility.sov.not-logged.setup_note: Retention only affects your own machine; pick a window that covers at least one full release cycle.
